description: The web guard on the legacy desktop: the web guard as the sandbox's non-admin viewer while accessroles-web-guard-probe.mjs gives it the probe's Kid role (Profile, Display (account), Home, Controls, Quick Connect, Jellyfin Enhanced locked; Display (this device), Playback, Subtitles open). The head fragment runs before jellyfin-web's bundles; the Settings page hides the four locked links and keeps Sign out; a click on a locked link, a JS navigation (the remote-command path), a typed locked URL on its first visit, a percent-encoded one, locked routes behind a second '#' (once a bypass), two locked navigations 400 ms apart (once a blank page) and a cold load all end on Home with the toast, and a frame recorder (an init script) never sees a locked page; Back after a redirect never returns to it; the Display page stays with its Display (account) fields disabled and the layout selector enabled; the pages a locked user can open save through their own forms: Display unchanged (no false toast: viewer's document holds neither Display (account) key, which the probe arranges) and Playback and Subtitles say nothing beyond jellyfin-web's own toast, a locked Display field changed is kept with the header and the guard's toast; a save of a locked setting through jellyfin-web's own ApiClient is kept by the server and says so in a toast. The form saves change nothing in the end: Playback's change is saved back and the usersettings document put back as it was.

steps.name: a frame recorder of the settings pages, before any page script
steps.initScript: (() => { const R = window.__jfarRec = { frames: {}, dom: null }; const tick = () => { try { document.querySelectorAll('.page.userPreferencesPage:not(#userPluginPreferencesPage)').forEach((p) => { if (!p.classList.contains('hide') && p.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(p).visibility !== 'hidden') { R.frames[p.id] = (R.frames[p.id] || 0) + 1; } }); } catch (e) { } requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { R.dom = document.documentElement.className; }); })()

steps.name: a recorder of the settings saves' answers (method, path, status, X-AccessRoles-Kept), before any page script
steps.initScript: (() => { window.__jfarSaves = []; const f = window.fetch; window.fetch = function (input, init) { const p = f.apply(this, arguments); const url = String((input && input.url) || input); const method = String((init && init.method) || (input && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (method !== 'GET' && /\/(DisplayPreferences|Users)\//.test(url)) { p.then((r) => { window.__jfarSaves.push({ method: method, path: url.replace(/^.*?\/\/[^/]+/, '').split('?')[0], status: r.status, kept: r.headers.get('X-AccessRoles-Kept') }); }, () => {}); } return p; }; })()

steps.name: sign in as viewer
viewer's id
the guard has viewer's /Me
the head fragment ran before jellyfin-web's bundles (inline, once; no Events, no ApiClient yet, the document still loading)
viewer's locks are classes on <html>, jfar-pending gone
the drawer's Settings link stays (not every section is locked)
open the Settings menu
the Settings menu is shown
the Settings page: Profile, Home screen, Controls and Quick Connect hidden; Display, Playback, Subtitles and Sign out shown; no note
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#myPreferencesMenuPage:not(.hide)'); const d = (s) => { const e = p.querySelector(s); return e ? getComputedStyle(e).display : 'missing'; }; return d('.lnkUserProfile') === 'none' && d('.lnkHomePreferences') === 'none' && d('.lnkControlsPreferences') === 'none' && d('.lnkQuickConnectPreferences') !== 'block' && d('.lnkDisplayPreferences') !== 'none' && d('.lnkPlaybackPreferences') !== 'none' && d('.lnkSubtitlePreferences') !== 'none' && d('.btnLogout') !== 'none' && !p.querySelector('[data-jfar-note]'); })()

steps.name: what the guard says it hides
a click on the hidden Profile link stops there, with the toast
steps.script: const link = document.querySelector('#myPreferencesMenuPage:not(.hide) .lnkUserProfile'); link.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return { hash: location.hash, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast')].map((t) => t.textContent) };

steps.name: still on the Settings menu, the toast shown
steps.assert: __vars.click.hash.startsWith('#/mypreferencesmenu') && __vars.click.toasts.includes('This page is managed by your server administrator.')

steps.name: a JS navigation to Quick Connect (the remote-command path, a lazy route)
steps.script: Dashboard.navigate('quickconnect'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return location.hash;

steps.name: Quick Connect ended on Home
back to the Settings menu
the Settings menu again
type the Home screen settings' URL (a legacy view, its first visit)
steps.script: location.hash = '#/mypreferenceshome'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: the typed URL ended on Home
a percent-encoded form of it
steps.script: location.hash = '#/MyPreferences%48ome.html?userId=' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return location.hash;

steps.name: the encoded URL ended on Home
Back after a redirect never shows the locked page
steps.script: history.back(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: Back went to a page that isn't locked
no locked page was visible in any frame
the frame counts of the locked pages are 0
locked routes behind a second '#' (the router reads '#/mypreferenceshome#x' as /mypreferenceshome)
steps.script: const out = {}; for (const v of ['#/mypreferenceshome#x', '#/mypreferenceshome/#x', '#/userprofile#x', '#/mypreferencescontrols#frag']) { location.hash = '#/mypreferencesmenu'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1800)); location.hash = v; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); out[v] = location.hash; } return out;

steps.name: each ended on Home
two locked navigations 400 ms apart (Home screen, then Controls)
steps.script: location.hash = '#/mypreferencesmenu'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); location.hash = '#/mypreferenceshome'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); location.hash = '#/mypreferencescontrols'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000)); const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('.page')].find((x) => !x.classList.contains('hide') && x.getClientRects().length > 0); return { hash: location.hash, shown: p ? p.id || p.className : null, blocking: document.documentElement.classList.contains('jfar-blocking'), log: __jfkit.jfar.instance.accessRoles.log().slice(-8).map((e) => e.type + ':' + (e.reason || e.blocked || '')) };

steps.name: it ended on Home, shown, never a blank page under a locked hash
still no locked page in any frame
a cold load of the Profile page
the guard has /Me again
the cold load ended on Home, the lock classes set from the cache before the bundles ran, no frame of Profile
open Display
Display is shown with its fields
Display (account) fields disabled, the layout selector enabled
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#displayPreferencesPage:not(.hide)'); const images = p.querySelector('#chkUseEpisodeImagesInNextUp'); return p.querySelector('.chkDisplayMissingEpisodes').disabled === true && (!images || images.disabled === true) && p.querySelector('.selectLayout').disabled === false; })()

steps.name: viewer's configuration and usersettings document before the form saves
the precondition: neither Display (account) key stored (the probe took them out)
a recorder of every toast, jellyfin-web's and the guard's
steps.script: window.__jfarToasts = []; new MutationObserver(() => { document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast, .toast').forEach((t) => { const s = t.textContent.trim(); if (s && !t.__jfarSeen) { t.__jfarSeen = true; window.__jfarToasts.push(s); } }); }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); return true;

steps.name: Display saved unchanged through its own form (its Display (account) fields disabled)
steps.script: window.__jfarSaves.length = 0; window.__jfarToasts.length = 0;  document.querySelector("#displayPreferencesPage:not(.hide) .btnSave").click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return { saves: window.__jfarSaves.slice(), toasts: window.__jfarToasts.slice() };

steps.name: nothing kept, no 'weren't changed' toast, jellyfin-web's 'Settings saved.' (once a false toast)
steps.assert: __vars.displaySame.saves.length > 0 && __vars.displaySame.saves.every((s) => s.status < 300 && !s.kept) && !__vars.displaySame.toasts.some((t) => t.indexOf('so they weren') >= 0) && __vars.displaySame.toasts.includes('Settings saved.') && __vars.displaySame.saves.some((s) => s.path === '/DisplayPreferences/usersettings')

steps.name: Display saved with a locked field changed by script (Display missing episodes)
steps.script: window.__jfarSaves.length = 0; window.__jfarToasts.length = 0; const box = document.querySelector('#displayPreferencesPage:not(.hide) .chkDisplayMissingEpisodes'); box.checked = !box.checked; document.querySelector("#displayPreferencesPage:not(.hide) .btnSave").click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return { saves: window.__jfarSaves.slice(), toasts: window.__jfarToasts.slice() };

steps.name: the server kept it, answered X-AccessRoles-Kept: DisplayAccount, and the guard's toast says so
steps.assert: (async () => { const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).Configuration; return c.DisplayMissingEpisodes === __vars.formBefore.config.DisplayMissingEpisodes && __vars.displayLocked.saves.some((s) => /\/Configuration$/.test(s.path) && s.status === 204 && s.kept === 'DisplayAccount') && __vars.displayLocked.toasts.includes('Some of these settings are managed by your server administrator, so they weren\'t changed: Display (account).'); })()

steps.name: nothing kept, no toast but jellyfin-web's
viewer's usersettings document put back as it was before the form saves (the merges keep its locked keys)
steps.script: await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', __vars.formBefore.prefs, ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); return true;

steps.name: the document and the configuration are as they were (AudioLanguagePreference, SubtitleLanguagePreference and CastReceiverId never set taken as empty: jellyfin-web's forms post an empty text for them)
steps.assert: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const sorted = (o) => JSON.stringify(Object.keys(o || {}).sort().map((k) => [k, o[k]])); const blank = (c) => Object.assign({}, c, { AudioLanguagePreference: c.AudioLanguagePreference || '', SubtitleLanguagePreference: c.SubtitleLanguagePreference || '', CastReceiverId: c.CastReceiverId || '' }); const prefs = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); const config = (await ApiClient.getUser(id)).Configuration; return sorted(prefs.CustomPrefs) === sorted(__vars.formBefore.prefs.CustomPrefs) && sorted(blank(config)) === sorted(blank(__vars.formBefore.config)); })()

steps.name: the stored configuration before
a save of a locked setting through jellyfin-web's ApiClient (Hide watched content from Latest, Home screen)
steps.script: const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(id)).Configuration; c.HidePlayedInLatest = !c.HidePlayedInLatest; await ApiClient.updateUserConfiguration(id, c); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast')].map((t) => t.textContent);

steps.name: the server kept it, and the toast says so
steps.assert: (async () => { const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).Configuration; return c.HidePlayedInLatest === __vars.before.HidePlayedInLatest && __vars.keptToasts.some((t) => t.indexOf('so they weren') >= 0 && t.indexOf('Home screen') >= 0); })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
